integration_bindings_role_stages_chk.name: integration_bindings_role_stages_chk
integration_bindings_role_stages_chk.value: (role = 'service' AND cardinality(stages) = 0) OR (role = 'deploy' AND array_ndims(stages) = 1 AND cardinality(stages) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND stages <@ ARRAY['preview', 'live'] AND (cardinality(stages) = 1 OR stages[1] <> stages[2]))

jobs_active_unique.name: jobs_active_unique
jobs_active_unique.where: status IN ('queued','dispatched','running','held') AND issue_id IS NOT NULL

jobs_finished_archive_idx.name: jobs_finished_archive_idx
jobs_finished_archive_idx.where: archive_path IS NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL

projects_live_branch_chk.name: projects_live_branch_chk
projects_live_branch_chk.value: release_model <> 'promote' OR live_branch IS NOT NULL

projects_release_strategy_chk.name: projects_release_strategy_chk
projects_release_strategy_chk.value: (release_model = 'promote') = (release_strategy IS NOT NULL) AND (release_strategy IS NULL OR release_strategy IN ('merge-branch', 'cherry-pick', 'tag-mr'))

reconcile_runs_pending_gate_idx.name: reconcile_runs_pending_gate_idx
reconcile_runs_pending_gate_idx.where: (status = 'decided' AND gate = 'human') OR (status = 'escalated' AND verdict = 'escalate' AND acknowledged_at IS NULL)

notifications_ops_alert_active_uq.name: notifications_ops_alert_active_uq
notifications_ops_alert_active_uq.where: resolved_at IS NULL AND resolution_key IS NOT NULL AND type = 'ops_alert'

notifications_signal_has_no_resolve_stat.name: notifications_signal_has_no_resolve_state
notifications_signal_has_no_resolve_stat.value: kind <> 'signal' OR (resolution_key IS NULL AND resolved_at IS NULL)

notifications_state_belongs_to_kind.name: notifications_state_belongs_to_kind
notifications_state_belongs_to_kind.value: (kind = 'signal' AND state IN ('emitted','expired')) OR (kind = 'condition' AND state IN ('pending','firing','inhibited','resolved')) OR (kind = 'task' AND state IN ('open','acknowledged','done','dismissed'))

rcq_threads_issue_live_idx.name: rcq_threads_issue_live_idx
rcq_threads_issue_live_idx.where: issue_id IS NOT NULL AND retired_at IS NULL

session_inbox_unresolved_idx.name: session_inbox_unresolved_idx
session_inbox_unresolved_idx.where: send_confirmed_at IS NULL OR (send_outcome = 'unknown' AND applied_at IS NULL)

conversation_participants_live_user_uniq.name: conversation_participants_live_user_unique
conversation_participants_live_user_uniq.where: removed_at IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL

conversation_participants_handle_has_pro.name: conversation_participants_handle_has_project
conversation_participants_handle_has_pro.value: "conversation_participants"."kind" <> 'handle' OR "conversation_participants"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL OR "conversation_participants"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

conversation_participants_person_identif.name: conversation_participants_person_identified
conversation_participants_person_identif.value: "conversation_participants"."kind" <> 'person' OR "conversation_participants"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "conversation_participants"."external_key" IS NOT NULL

conversation_windows_one_collecting.name: conversation_windows_one_collecting
conversation_windows_one_collecting.where: claimed_at IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL

conversation_windows_closed_was_claimed.name: conversation_windows_closed_was_claimed
conversation_windows_closed_was_claimed.value: "conversation_windows"."closed_at" IS NULL OR "conversation_windows"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL
